text.description_html:
Simplex Keypad Exit Device Trim with Key Override

The KABA Simplex LP1020 Heavy Duty Keypad Exit Device Trim with Key Override features strong rugged design and construction, well known for its durability and an ADA compliant door lever. Provides exterior access by combination, while allowing free egress with exit device. Easy to install, program and maintain. Exit device may be dogged without affecting the LP1020.

Limit access to high-traffic, security-sensitive areas in commercial, institutional and industrial buildings. Ideal for locations with frequent personal turnover such as data processing centers, employee entrances, motels, dormitories, volunteer fire departments, airports and hospitals.

Features of the KABA Simplex LP1020

  • Easy to maintain - no batteries to replace.
  • Durable heavy-duty construction.
  • Single access code—one easy to manage code for all users
  • Easily programmed via keypad without removing lock from the door
  • Highly weather resistant
  • ADA Compliant
  • Compliant with Paragraph 36A of the Industrial Security Manual published by the U.S. Department of Defense

Specifications of KABA Simplex LP1020

  • Construction: Heavy duty with cast front housing with heavy duty mounting plate and fixed ADA Compliant Lever.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 2-1/4"
  • Minimum Stile: 5"
  • Door Preparation: Recessed thru bolts may be required for Exit Device preparation
  • Key Override: Schlage "C" Keyway Interchangeable Core I/C (Less Core). Optional small format Interchangeable Core I/C (Less Core) - Best, Corbin/Russwin, Medeco or Sargent.
  • Handing: Factory handed, not field reversible
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, mechanical 5 button keypad, anodized aluminum.
  • Fire Rating: Three (3) hour UL/ULC fire rating for "A" labeled doors.
  • Environmental: Highly weather resistant; for exterior or interior use.
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Warranty: Three (3) Years.

**Exterior trim only. Exit device sold separately.**
